title: Unify embeddings/rerank observability signals and per-route cost tracing
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Create a single, low-overhead observability pipeline that exposes per-route metrics, distributed traces, and precise cost attribution for embeddings and reranking requests. This work unifies signals from the embedding index layer, reranker scoring, model serving (token counts / kv cache hits), and request routing so product and SRE teams can quickly diagnose quality regressions, latency spikes, and unexpected cost growth per API route or customer namespace.
acceptance_criteria: Per-route dashboard template available in Console with: P95/P99 latency, median rerank scoring time, embedding search time, kv-cache hit rate, tokens generated, and computed cost-per-request
Distributed tracing spans emitted for: client request -> index lookup -> reranker scoring -> model inference, with correlation_id propagated end-to-end
Cost attribution computed and stored per-request (model token cost + infra cost + search cost) and surfaced in UI for last 90 days
Alerting rules in place for: route-level latency regressions, cost-per-request drift >20% week-over-week, and rerank quality drop measured by offline eval probes
Instrumentation overhead stays below 5% p99 latency increase for production sampling rates
tasks: Design telemetry schema for embedding/rerank events and spans
Extend trace context propagation in reranker service and indexer (add correlation_id header)
Add per-request cost fields to usage events and sink into billing pipeline
Create dashboard template and wiring for per-route aggregation in Console
Implement alerting playbook and automated incident runbook links
E2E test and run a gradual canary across 5% -> 25% -> 100% traffic
Post-deploy validation and performance benchmark (latency overhead and cost accuracy)
updates: 2026-02-20 - Asha created ticket after postmortem for SEV-512 identified lack of per-route cost visibility.
2026-02-24 - Architecture sync w/ infra and billing: decided to compute cost-per-request at ingestion using model token price + index op estimate to avoid heavy joins downstream.
2026-02-28 - Prototype trace propagation merged in reranker service; added correlation_id header. Benchmark shows +1.8% median latency at 10k RPS in staging.
2026-03-03 - Design review with PM and Design: dashboard layout approved; requested add 'reranker score distribution' panel and per-customer breakdown filter.
2026-03-06 - Billing group flagged edge case: cached model outputs should be accounted as zero model-token cost; added KV-hit boolean to usage event schema.

2026-03-08 - Started canary on internal routes (5% traffic). Observed expected correlation of rerank latency spikes with index shard contention on two hosts; filed ENG-27011 to fix shard hot-spotting.
notes: Trade-offs: emitting full spans at 100% traffic increases observability fidelity but adds CPU overhead. We will use dynamic sampling by route and degrade to traces-on-error for low-traffic routes.
Cost model: token_price * model_tokens + infra_estimate(model_type, seq_len) + index_search_cost. We'll iterate to refine index_search_cost after initial telemetry collection.
Privacy: request-level cost attribution will not store raw customer data; will reference hashed namespace IDs to align with privacy policy.
